title: FOMC minutes (December 7-8 2027 meeting) — the year's last minutes, and the first read on the final SEP's dissent structure
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this lane (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes), states the convention verbatim — the minutes of a regularly scheduled meeting are published three weeks after the date of the policy decision. The 2027 panel gives the meeting as 'December 7-8*'; the policy decision is Wednesday 2027-12-08, and three weeks later is Wednesday 2027-12-29 (computed, not assumed). THE RULE IS VALIDATED 6 OF 6 AGAINST THE MINUTES ENTRIES THIS CALENDAR ALREADY CARRIES, re-checked by this session rather than taken on trust: 2026-09-16 → fomc-minutes-2026-10-07, 2026-10-28 → 2026-11-18, 2026-12-09 → 2026-12-30, 2027-06-09 → 2027-06-30, 2027-07-28 → 2027-08-18, 2027-09-15 → 2027-10-06. It also reproduces the sibling proposal fomc-minutes-2027-11-17 (2027-10-27 + 21 days) that the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 lane filed on the same rule. Filed estimate because it is a firm publication convention applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date — fomccalendars.htm states verbatim 'Each meeting date is tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it', so the promotion trigger is the 2027-10-26/27 meeting ratifying December 7-8, not a better fetch. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-blackout-start-2027-11-27 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-08), on the precedent the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 lane set when it proposed the minutes of the meeting ITS gate wrapped. This is the same move one meeting later: the gate 2027-11-27 → 2027-12-09 wraps the December 7-8 meeting, and these are that meeting's minutes. WHY THE DATE EARNS A ROW BEYOND THE ARITHMETIC. (1) It is the LAST Fed communication of 2027 and the first look inside the year's final SEP — the December meeting carries the projection asterisk on the Board's own panel, so the minutes are where the dispersion behind those projections becomes readable. (2) It lands on 2027-12-29, in the thinnest tape of the year: the sessions between Christmas and New Year. This calendar already treats that stretch as structurally distinct (christmas-eve-half-day-2026-12-24, sifma-uk-bond-market-closure-2026-12-28), and a medium-impact Fed release landing inside it is a mismatch worth having on the board rather than discovering late. (3) It is three weeks clear of this proposer's own window, so it does not affect the gate's stance and is not used to support it. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is calendar-keyed, and the proposer's own measurements were about gate geometry and boundary sessions — they do not transfer to a minutes release. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
